name: Our Flag Means Death
description: After trading in the seemingly charmed life of a gentleman for one of a swashbuckling buccaneer, Stede Bonnet becomes captain of the pirate ship Revenge. Struggling to earn the respect of his potentially mutinous crew, Stede’s fortunes change after a fateful run-in with the infamous Captain Blackbeard. Stede and crew attempt to get their ship together and survive life on the high seas.

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: Aristocrat-turned-pirate-captain Stede Bonnet is put to the test when his crew encounters a British naval vessel.

videos.title: A Damned Man
videos.overview: Stede battles feelings of guilt while hunting for missing hostages. Lucius makes a surprising discovery.

videos.title: A Gentleman Pirate
videos.overview: Stede (a.k.a. “The Gentleman Pirate”) conducts business in the Republic of Pirates. Oluwande and Jim face their past.

videos.title: Discomfort in a Married State
videos.overview: As the threat of attack looms, Blackbeard and Stede finally meet. Jim fields questions from an overly curious crew.

videos.title: The Best Revenge Is Dressing Well
videos.overview: Blackbeard and Stede attend a fancy party. Oluwande and Frenchie embrace false identities. Izzy and Lucius go head-to-head.

videos.title: The Art of F**kery
videos.overview: Stede and crew stage a spectacle. Blackbeard struggles to carry out his plan.

videos.title: This Is Happening
videos.overview: A trip to St. Augustine reveals more about Jim’s past. Stede leads Blackbeard on an adventure.

videos.title: We Gull Way Back
videos.overview: The arrival of Blackbeard’s old buddy leaves Stede feeling like the odd man out. As Oluwande mourns a loss, Jim seeks answers from Spanish Jackie.

videos.title: Act of Grace
videos.overview: Captured and facing trial, Stede and Blackbeard face tough choices and an uncertain future.

videos.title: Wherever You Go, There You Are
videos.overview: While Stede attempts to reenter his old life, Blackbeard tends to a wounded heart.

videos.title: Impossible Birds
videos.overview: While Stede adjusts to his new normal, a heartbroken Blackbeard fills the void with daily raids – sparking concern amongst Izzy and the crew.

videos.title: Red Flags
videos.overview: Aboard Zheng's ship, Stede, Olu, and Black Pete have surprising revelations while Blackbeard's crew plots their revenge.

videos.title: The Innkeeper
videos.overview: While the Revenge crew gleefully reunites under Zheng's reign, Stede attempts to bring back Blackbeard, who must face his own difficult truths.

videos.title: Fun and Games
videos.overview: After he's banished from the Revenge, Blackbeard unwittingly receives relationship advice from some dysfunctional old friends.

videos.title: The Curse of the Seafaring Life
videos.overview: As Blackbeard remains plagued by the distrust of his crew, Izzy schools Stede on how to be an effective captain.

videos.title: Calypso's Birthday
videos.overview: While the crew celebrates Calypso's birthday, Blackbeard faces a violent party-crasher seeking revenge.

videos.title: Man on Fire
videos.overview: As Blackbeard reevaluates his life, Stede revels in his newfound infamy. With some help from Jim, Oluwande reunites with a hesitant Zheng.

videos.title: Mermen
videos.overview: After watching the Republic of Pirates crumble, Stede and Zheng pursue Prince Ricky Barnes, the Revenge crew schemes to escape imprisonment, and Blackbeard plots a return to piracy… leading to triumph and a devastating loss.
